title: Field Force App
shortDescription: An enterprise field workforce and sales management mobile app built with Flutter, BLoC, Google Maps, and Firebase.
description: An enterprise-grade field workforce management system developed for Samsung sales teams using Flutter and Clean Architecture. Key capabilities include real-time employee attendance tracking with camera verification and GPS geofencing, leave request & approval workflows, field stock & inventory management, interactive performance charts, and remote over-the-air app updates.

title: Medical AI Multi-Tool Agent System
shortDescription: Enterprise-grade clinical AI assistant bridging structured SQL patient datasets with real-time medical literature search, zero-downtime multi-LLM fallback, and graceful degradation.
description: An enterprise-grade, fault-tolerant clinical AI assistant designed to bridge structured patient datasets with live medical search. Features multi-database SQL agents for natural language querying across SQLite clinical datasets (Cardiology, Oncology, Metabolic health), real-time clinical guidelines & literature search via Tavily Search API, zero-downtime multi-LLM fallback chaining (Google Gemini & OpenAI GPT-4o-mini via LangChain .with_fallbacks), and a contextual medical fallback engine ensuring 0% crash rates during API quotas or network drops.

title: Bangla Book Knowledge Base RAG Chatbot
shortDescription: End-to-end RAG system built on Bengali classic 'দেবদাস' with automated chapter crawler, dense bge-m3 embeddings, morphological stemmer, and clickable citations.
description: An end-to-end Bengali RAG application built on the classic novel 'দেবদাস' (Devdas) from Bengali Wikisource. Engineered an automated crawler with paragraph-preserving chunking, hybrid retrieval pairing dense embeddings (bge-m3) with a Bengali morphological stemmer achieving 100% retrieval hit rate, verified grounding with clickable chapter citations and refusal safeguards, and a real-time conversational interface powered by Streamlit and Groq.

title: Bangladesh Multi-Tool AI Agent
shortDescription: Autonomous multi-tool agent intelligently routing questions across Bangladesh hospital data, academic institutions, restaurants, and live web search.
description: A Bangladesh-focused autonomous AI agent that interprets user intent in natural language and dynamically routes requests to the optimal data source. Connects structured SQLite databases covering hospitals, colleges/schools, and restaurants with live Tavily web search via LangChain and Google Gemini function calling. Packaged with a Streamlit interface and Docker containerization.

title: AI LinkedIn Post Generator
shortDescription: Multi-lingual LinkedIn content generation agent supporting 5 languages with structural validation, viral hooks, hashtag suggestions, and .txt export.
description: An intelligent generative AI assistant built with Python, Streamlit, LangChain, and Google Gemini to automatically produce professional, publish-ready LinkedIn posts. Features multi-lingual generation across English, Bengali, Hindi, Spanish, and French, automated hook crafting and CTA optimization, agent validation for post structure and paragraph counts, and instant .txt file exports.
